preconditions.description: The number of town attractions is between 3 and 20, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= matrix[i][j] <= 1000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
postconditions.description: All elements in the adjacency matrix are non-negative and not greater than 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[i][j] == matrix[j][i] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
all(matrix[i][j] != matrix[i][k] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) for k in range(N) if j != k and j != i and k != i)
postconditions.description: All elements in the matrix are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[i][j] > 0 for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
postconditions.description: All elements in the matrix are positive.
The number of distinct positive elements equals the number of unique pairs of attractions, which is N*(N-1)/2.
